prompts.arcane_shield: Use case: stylized-concept. One isolated physical fantasy spell card, Arcane Shield, intended as reference for image-to-3D modeling in a chess game. Solid pure BLACK background (#000000), no floor, no scenery, no external shadow. Entire object fully visible centered with generous margins. Portrait rectangular rigid card, rounded corners, substantial 4 mm thickness, antique GOLD raised frame with simple symmetric engraved corners, deep VIOLET enamel face (not black), raised silver-and-violet SHIELD with a clear plus cross at the center. Shield is integrated into the card face as a bold bas-relief, not floating. Slight 10 degree three-quarter view to reveal the thickness, front face strongly visible, upright. Clean stylized PBR 3D studio render, bright neutral soft illumination for readable geometry and crisp silhouette. Absolutely NO text, letters, numbers, logos or watermark. Single card only, no other objects. Frame and relief substantial, physically connected, suitable for real-time game model.
